honest_c3_caveats: phi_star_v3_canonical is L1+L2 proxy — phenomenal consciousness L3 NOT measured (per #100 epistemic ceiling)
straight-through estimator on EMA introduces gradient bias — true Pareto may differ from optimized point
HID=8 well-conditioned probe is one of many possible probes; sign-stability across HID values not measured here
5.0 threshold is 8x safety margin heuristic, not first-principles derived; tighter threshold (e.g., 10) would be safer but reduces LoRA training freedom
